name: finmesh-features
changes_from_v1: History and new-counterparty features depend only on the previous history_hours instead of everything since the observation start. In v1 they grew with time by construction (age_windows had drift PSI 7 from train to validation on the fixture), so a model trained on early windows would meet different values later. age_windows is replaced by recency_windows, and the history rates divide by the full span. Every v2 feature depends only on the current window and the previous history_hours, so it is stationary once history_hours have passed; earlier windows are a training burn-in (meta: history_complete_from_window).
unit: account-window: one account held at a federation member, in one window, with at least one transaction

keys.name: window
keys.definition: zero-based window number since the observation start

params.rate_source: median amount_received / amount_paid per currency pair on train-partition rows, chained to the reference currency

conventions: Every feature is computed from the holding member's own view (finmesh.data.visibility): rows in which one of its accounts sends or receives.

A leg is one side of a transaction for the account: outbound (it pays) or inbound (it is paid). A self-transfer has the same account on both sides; it counts in self_tx and in history totals and is excluded from every counterparty or graph feature.
Amounts are converted to the reference currency with data-derived rates; legs in a currency with no rate count in unconvertible_share and are left out of amount sums.

History features (and new counterparties) depend only on the previous history_hours, so they mean the same in every period once history_hours have passed since the observation start; earlier windows are a training burn-in (meta: history_complete_from_window).

Neighbourhood features use the member's visible graph over the lookback (the current window and the earlier ones within lookback_hours): distinct directed account pairs, timing ignored inside the lookback. Intermediate accounts in 2-paths must have visible degree at most hub_degree_cap.
Shares and ratios are null when their denominator is empty; counts and sums are 0.

features.name: tx_out
features.definition: outbound legs, excluding self-transfers

features.name: tx_in
features.definition: inbound legs, excluding self-transfers

features.name: self_tx
features.definition: self-transfers

features.name: amt_out
features.definition: sum of outbound amounts (reference currency)

features.name: amt_in
features.definition: sum of inbound amounts (reference currency)

features.name: amt_out_max
features.definition: largest outbound amount; 0 when none

features.name: amt_in_max
features.definition: largest inbound amount; 0 when none

features.name: amt_net
features.definition: amt_in - amt_out

features.name: active_span_h
features.definition: hours between the first and the last leg in the window

features.name: currencies_n
features.definition: distinct currencies on the account's own side of its legs

features.name: cross_currency_share
features.definition: share of legs whose payment and receiving currencies differ

features.name: unconvertible_share
features.definition: share of legs whose amount has no reference-currency rate

features.name: fmt_ach_share
features.definition: share of legs paid by ACH

features.name: fmt_bitcoin_share
features.definition: share of legs paid in Bitcoin

features.name: fmt_cash_share
features.definition: share of legs paid in cash

features.name: fmt_cheque_share
features.definition: share of legs paid by cheque

features.name: fmt_credit_card_share
features.definition: share of legs paid by credit card

features.name: fmt_reinvestment_share
features.definition: share of legs that are reinvestments

features.name: fmt_wire_share
features.definition: share of legs paid by wire

features.name: fan_out
features.definition: distinct counterparties paid

features.name: fan_in
features.definition: distinct counterparties paying in

features.name: out_amount_hhi
features.definition: Herfindahl index of outbound amounts across counterparties (1 = one counterparty)

features.name: in_amount_hhi
features.definition: Herfindahl index of inbound amounts across counterparties

features.name: pass_through
features.definition: min(amt_in, amt_out) / max(amt_in, amt_out)

features.name: in_out_delay_min_h
features.definition: over outbound legs in the window: shortest time since the latest earlier inbound leg (within delay_tolerance_hours), in hours

features.name: in_out_delay_med_h
features.definition: median of the same delays

features.name: cross_bank_share
features.definition: share of legs whose counterparty is at another bank

features.name: cross_member_share
features.definition: share of legs whose counterparty is at another federation member

features.name: outside_share
features.definition: share of legs whose counterparty bank is outside the federation

features.name: new_cp_n
features.definition: counterparties in this window not seen by the account in the previous history_hours

features.name: new_cp_share
features.definition: new_cp_n / distinct counterparties in the window

features.name: recency_windows
features.definition: windows since the account's previous active window; history window + 1 when there is none within history_hours

features.name: prior_active_windows
features.definition: windows within the previous history_hours in which the account had a leg

features.name: prior_leg_rate
features.definition: legs per window over the previous history_hours (legs in that span / its length in windows)

features.name: legs_vs_history
features.definition: log1p(legs in this window) - log1p(prior_leg_rate)

features.name: amt_vs_history
features.definition: log1p(amt_in + amt_out) - log1p(amount per window over the previous history_hours)

features.name: nb_out_deg
features.definition: distinct accounts paid over the lookback

features.name: nb_in_deg
features.definition: distinct accounts paying in over the lookback

features.name: gs_min_fan
features.definition: min(nb_in_deg, nb_out_deg): gather-scatter hub indicator

features.name: cyc2
features.definition: visible 2-cycles a->b->a through the account

features.name: cyc3
features.definition: visible simple 3-cycles a->b->c->a through the account (b within the hub cap)

features.name: cyc4
features.definition: visible simple 4-cycles a->b->c->d->a through the account (b and d within the hub cap)

features.name: sg_out_max
features.definition: max over accounts c of distinct b with a->b->c: scatter-gather source indicator

features.name: sg_in_max
features.definition: max over accounts c of distinct b with c->b->a: scatter-gather sink indicator

features.name: cp_in_deg_max
features.definition: largest visible in-degree among accounts the account paid: feeder of a gather hub

features.name: cp_out_deg_max
features.definition: largest visible out-degree among accounts that paid the account: receiver from a scatter hub

features.name: hub_neighbours
features.definition: neighbours over the lookback whose visible degree exceeds the hub cap
